notes.title: Update to v0.23.112a (Cave Cricket)
notes.content:
Welp, it's another day and more tasty updates! Let's just jump-in, shall we!

[list]
[*] Updated Item descriptions to be nice and fancy!
[*] Moved bushes further so collecting berries is corrected now.
[*] Missing-A-Thumb attribute was broken. Fixed this by adding an extra variable, increasing the odds to 1 in 20, adding a popup message and adding an Adventure Log entry for it.
[*] Made sure every object is deleted appropriately on the dungeon levels when traveling both down to new levels or out. Apparently I had forgotten to do this and dead bodies, chests and gore remained.
[*] Slightly revamped the popup alert system to show everything that gets picked up and to have a queue formed so no messages are missed.
[*] No longer can players walk on water. No, you cannot be Jesus.
[*] You can no longer step on Calvin (or any other NPCs for that matter). Go ahead and try... I dare you!
[/list]
That'll do!

Talk to you all on the next update!

notes.title: Update to v0.22.106a (Cave Cricket)
notes.content:
Update to v0.22.106a (Cave Cricket) 11.7.2024

Hello, my dear players! My friend Abraxas86 took the time to test out the game and managed to break many things! Because of this, I went straight to work this morning to try and fix a large swath of those bugs he found! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Contact The Dev was removed from previous versions. This has been fixed! You can now suitably nag me once again!
[*] Code for restoring stack counts for items from Saved Games was missing the SaveGame.Get("") functions. This resulted in stack counts receiving NaN since the variable being inserted was "hero.slot#.items.stackcount" instead of the actual number. This was fixed for all items as well as the ammo slot.
[*] Map borders were non-existent before today. This was corrected by creating a 1x1 sprite, stretching it both Hor/Ver and running collision checks vs the hero.
[*] Quests were not loading properly from saved games. This was caused by the Calvin_dialogue variable not being correctly set in the dialogue tree. The quest tree has been reworked and set to match the saved games correctly!
[*] Disabled the ability to use ESC to toggle out of dialogue windows, as this was messing up the dialogue tree. For now, this is the way things need to be, but I may revisit this later to add some actions to the ESC key even when in dialogues so as not to screw the tree up.
[*] Revamped item drag-drop system to correct numerous bugs!
[*] Fixed collision boxes on items, which was making it very hard to properly equip things in their respective slots
[*] Added item descriptions for blueberries, barberries, grilled blueberries & grilled barberries.
[/list]
Anyway, that's all for now! Remember to stop by the Discord and say 'Yo!'

Until next update, 

Your pal,

Sam

[*] Code for restoring stack counts for items from Saved Games was missing the SaveGame.Get("") functions. This resulted in stack counts receiving NaN since the variable being inserted was "hero.slot#.items.stackcount" instead of the actual number. This was fixed for all items as well as the ammo slot.
[*] Map borders were non-existent before today. This was corrected by creating a 1x1 sprite, stretching it both Hor/Ver and running collision checks vs the hero.

[*] Quests were not loading properly from saved games. This was caused by the Calvin_dialogue variable not being correctly set in the dialogue tree. The quest tree has been reworked and set to match the saved games correctly!

[*] Disabled the ability to use ESC to toggle out of dialogue windows, as this was messing up the dialogue tree. For now, this is the way things need to be, but I may revisit this later to add some actions to the ESC key even when in dialogues so as not to screw the tree up.
[*] Revamped item drag-drop system to correct numerous bugs!
[*] Fixed collision boxes on items, which was making it very hard to properly equip things in their respective slots

tags.feature: [*] Added item descriptions for blueberries, barberries, grilled blueberries & grilled barberries.

notes.title: Update to v0.21.95a (Cave Cricket)
notes.content:
Hey all you crazy cats! It's time for another episode of 'Whats. Been. Fixed!'

So, here ya go:

[list]
[*] Z-ordering applied to hero/equipped weapons and trees (zOrdering can be applied to everything now)
[*] Added new layer above hero & NPC's for bedroll top (among other things...)
[*] Hitboxes for trees and the campfire got an upgrade! (i.e. they are better now)
[*] Destroy sticks that are overlapping trees (and thus unobtainable) [Bug Found by CriticalFailure]
[*] Fixed popup alert appearing when colliding with stackable items even if your inventory is full
[*] Newly crafting items or item components will drop now if a hero's inventory is full
[*] Added the ability to create multiple items/enemies in debug tools at one shot for quicker testing
[*] Multiple issues with how stackable items are handled within the general inventory system, cooking and crafting.
[*] Fixed Bug where dragging a stack, then hitting CTRL would double the stack... (reminded me of things like the Dupe bug in Diablo lol)
[*] Disabled debug mode in the playtest!  Sorry ya'all, you can't cheat that way anymore lol
[/list]

notes.title: Update to v.0.21.85a (Cave Cricket)
notes.content:
Hey kids!

Only one change in this patch, but it's a doozy!
Holding down a directional button will now allow a character to keep walking, vs having to hit the directional key EVERY SINGLE TIME!

Get across the map faster! Impress your friends!

Thanks and talk to you soon!
